resources.string:
I maintain Monica Pass on my own in my spare time. It is **completely free** and the code is **fully open source**, so you can look at it anytime.

**You control your passwords and data**, including whether to back them up or sync them. I cannot see them, and I will not make money from them.

If it has helped you, **donations of any amount** are welcome. US$2 is just a suggested amount I picked; feel free to lower it. I appreciate every contribution.

**No donation is needed; just enjoy using it for free.** Knowing that people use it and find it helpful already makes it worthwhile for me.
